• Gated Cognito Login: 1-click role persona switcher
• Tab 1: Document Viewer (Fetch, on-demand PDF, Batch ZIP & Page Splicing)
• Tab 2: Ingestion & Upload (Direct Presigned PUT, Web Crypto SHA-256 & AI Pre-Fill)

• Tab 4: AI Assistant (Amazon Bedrock Nova 2 Lite conversational chat & tool calling)

• Tab 6: Admin & Lifecycle (Soft-delete & Document restoration)
• Tab 7: System Health (APIGW & Lambda runtime probes)
• Tab 8: Active Session & JWT (Claims inspection & token viewer)
• Tab 9: Audit Inspector (Unified compliance logs & Bedrock LLM metrics)
• Tab 10: Cost Calculator (Interactive AWS multi-tier pricing model)

div.div:
① Presentation Tier: Serverless Web Portal SPA served globally via Amazon CloudFront Edge CDN backed by Amazon S3 ($0 idle cost).
② Identity & RBAC: Direct browser-to-Cognito SRP/USER_PASSWORD_AUTH; passes Bearer JWT to API Gateway authorizer.
③ Tri-Partite WORM Authority: S3 holds immutable binary versions and authoritative JSON annotations; DynamoDB acts purely as O(1) control plane.
④ Optimistic Concurrency Control: DynamoDB enforces current_metadata_revision = :expected to guarantee zero write collisions.
⑤ Amazon Bedrock AI Intelligence: Amazon Nova 2 Lite powers conversational assistance, stateless UI pre-filling, and async background PII enrichment with safety ratchets.
⑥ Event-Driven Async Projections: DynamoDB Streams CDC events are decoupled via SQS into OpenSearch Serverless and S3 compliance audit buckets.
